Chinese Airlines Report Significant First-Half Losses Amidst Fuel Costs

China's three largest airlines have reported substantial losses for the first half of the year. The primary factor cited for these financial setbacks is the significant impact of rising fuel costs. This situation has affected the profitability of these major carriers during the initial six months of the year.
